ns2:section.sectionText: We encourage you NOT to drop this lecture when changing your schedule as we will not be able to offer an override and you will need to wait until a seat is open (you are able to change your discussions without dropping the lecture by using the 'add/drop' function in self-service...please double check that the discussion matches the lecture and it has no restrictions). Econ 302 is structured in a lecture/discussion format. Students must register for a lecture and a discussion section starting with the same letter.
